grounds: The two files are not the same kind of thing, and the extension targets the right one. 'session-plan.md' IS the plan: ai_router.evidence declares SESSION_PLAN_FILENAME = 'session-plan.md', and it is the file the router itself reads for both the session titles (writers.register_session_start, line 254) and the plan steps it seeds into the activity log (writers.seed_session_plan, line 426). It carries 20 '### Session N of M:' headings, one per planned session. 'project-work-plan.md' is a GENERATED VIEW of the activity log, not a plan. Its own first lines say so -- 'Written by ai_router.writers as a fold of activity-log.json. Hand edits are overwritten by the next append. The record is the log; this page is one view of it.' -- and writers.py's module docstring says the same: 'The two prose files are projections, not records ... the markdown is folded from it on every append and may be deleted and rebuilt at any time.' Pointing the open action, the cache key, the watcher and the title heal at project-work-plan.md would aim every one of them at a file the framework regenerates, and would make the extension's titles disagree with the ones register_session_start writes. The finding's proposed fix would introduce the defect it describes. Note the round recorded agency: none -- the verifier could not read the tree, so it could not see that both files exist and which one the router reads.
